headline: Touchdown for the Chiefs!
what_happened: P.Mahomes threw a short pass to X.Worthy, who caught it in the end zone to score a touchdown, which is worth six points.
who: P.Mahomes and X.Worthy executed the play.
why_it_matters: This is great news for Kansas City! It adds points to their total and increases their chances of winning the game by 4 percentage points.
